title: Phone cases
material: Bambu TPU for AMS, neon green (68D)

items.name: The Forge
items.description: A bold central anvil silhouette framed by three rising flame ribbons, with a restrained solar disk above; connected angular ribs evoke a forge doorway. Ritual, discipline, fire. Charcoal black TPU.

items.name: Null Gate
items.description: One large quiet circular void-like recessed disk centered on the back, nested incomplete concentric rings radiate outward and meet a vertical axis, carefully spaced broad rounded grooves; minimalist mystical portal, zero and structured absence. Deep plum TPU.

items.name: Spacetime
items.description: A broad curved coordinate grid bends around an off-center circular gravity well in the lower middle. Smooth continuous raised ribs form a dramatic gravitational lens pattern, scientifically inspired artistic geometry. Midnight blue TPU.

items.name: Noether
items.description: Mathematical rotational symmetry expressed as a large sixfold geometric rosette, three concentric bands of interlocking rounded triangular cells, clear radial order, no equations or lettering, bold architectural negative spaces in shallow relief. Dark teal TPU.

items.name: Automaton
items.description: A striking abstract robot spinal column down the back, broad segmented vertebrae connected to symmetric sweeping circuit branches, two understated sensor disks near the shoulders below camera level; robotics designed as elegant anatomy, no humanoid face. Graphite gray TPU.

items.name: Source Current
items.description: Five broad flowing river contour ribbons sweep diagonally from the upper right to lower left, merge into a central organic stream then separate, calming asymmetric topography, a quiet small sun in the lower part. Petrol green TPU.

items.name: Desert Oracle
items.description: Architectural desert mysticism: broad sweeping dune relief in lower half, one rising sun disk and an abstract all-seeing eye made of simple connected geometric lines in the middle, upper right a minimal stepped temple contour. Sandstone beige TPU.

items.name: Mycelium
items.description: Organic branching network of thick rounded connected veins fans from bottom center to edges, generous irregular cellular spaces and rounded nodes, visual vocabulary of living fungal networks and distributed intelligence. Moss green TPU.

items.name: Celestial Navigator
items.description: A large minimalist astrolabe in the lower two-thirds, concentric circular bands, broad radial direction markers, three simple orbit arcs flow up toward upper right; navigation and celestial mechanics, no tiny star speckles, no writing. Deep indigo TPU.

items.name: Open Commons
items.description: An architectural network of interlocking open archways and bridges, staggered rounded rectangular apertures rendered as shallow recesses, a strong central open doorway connects to branching paths, distributed knowledge and access in tactile geometric relief. Burnt orange TPU.

items.name: Reactor Core
items.description: Industrial physics: one large circular reactor core in lower center, chunky segmented concentric rings and six thick radial conduits, asymmetrical upper vent-like recessed panels.

items.name: Cyber Scarab
items.description: Mysticism meets robotics: a bold geometric scarab with broad wing plates and six rounded circuit legs, solar disk above, strongly sculptural but shallow integrated relief.

items.name: Waveform
items.description: Physics: intersecting broad sinusoidal wave ribbons form a single dramatic interference field across the lower two-thirds, elegant repeating rhythm, generous spacing.

items.name: Xenobot
items.description: Soft robotics: an organic exoskeleton made of broad soft-edged overlapping armored cells and a central segmented flexible spine, otherworldly, no face.

items.name: Neon Labyrinth
items.description: Meditative mathematics: one continuous broad rectangular spiral labyrinth that winds inward around a quiet rectangular center, rounded turns, generous clean recessed channels.

items.name: Flux Lines
items.description: Electromagnetism: bold flowing magnetic field loops between two large circular poles diagonally offset along the back, curved broad ribs, sparse clean geometry.

items.name: Emerald Forge
items.description: Personal Forge emblem reinvented for neon green: an angular hammer silhouette suspended above a broad anvil, three large radiating spark shapes, strong stepped architectural framing, restrained negative space.

items.name: Fibonacci Bloom
items.description: Mathematics and nature: a large spiraling botanical rosette built from broad rounded petal plates in a phyllotaxis-inspired arrangement, tactile elegant offset center, no tiny dense details.

items.name: Serpent Circuit
items.description: Mystic technology: an abstract ouroboros serpent forms a single large broken circular loop, head suggested by simple geometric planes; broad circuit pathways run within its body and outward to border.

items.name: Tectonic
items.description: Geology and computational design: five large asymmetrical polygonal landform plates separated by broad rounded recessed fault channels, shallow faceted slopes and contour steps, bold minimalist technical look.

items.name: Neliel · Hollow Bloom
items.description: Your supplied horned portrait, simplified into flowing contours and a Fibonacci-like blossom.

items.name: Tatsumaki · Vector Storm
items.description: Swept curls and concentric telekinetic flow lines.

items.name: C.C. · Geass Garden
items.description: Long hair, a focused eye motif and botanical curves.

items.name: Zoro · Three Paths
items.description: A stern portrait and a three-sword geometric crest.

items.name: Midoriya · Full Cowl
items.description: Spiky hair and branching lightning channels.

items.name: Piccolo · Orbit
items.description: Angular facial planes, antennae and orbital arcs.

items.name: Spike · After Hours
items.description: A quiet portrait with flowing jazz-like linework.

items.name: Senku · Stone to Science
items.description: Swept hair, facial crack lines and molecular diagrams.

items.name: Cell · Bioforge
items.description: Organic armor cells and bold biomechanical geometry.

items.name: EVA-01 · Awakening
items.description: A mecha head, angular armor and circuit channels.

timeline.text: Three engraved cases sliced clean, then one was printed: too tight, the phone does not seat fully and an upper corner sits proud of the rim.
Scaled about 0.5 % wider and 0.6 % longer around the centre as a controlled starting trial; Apple's body size (77.6 × 160.7 × 7.85 mm) showed V1 relied on stretch.
Bottom-only length correction, deeper 1.2 mm channels and small detail samples to print first. No V3 physical print reported.
2 mm extension, corrected corners and exposed buttons, checked in a rigid 3D fit simulation. Physical fit pending.
Opened the bottom edge while keeping V4's fit and corner catches.
timeline.source: git log of the print archive: “Open TPU case bottoms while retaining V4 fit and corner catches”

timeline.text: Softly rounded lower corner pads; all meshes watertight and all projects slice without warnings or supports.
The ten anime concepts redrawn as 1.0 mm-deep line engravings on the V6 case, plus 40 × 40 mm detail tests; all 20 projects slice without warnings.

A new shell designed from scratch from Apple's published dimensions (0.25 mm clearance, 2.0 mm back), with sculpted relief plates made from the concepts. Frame and plates slice clean with no supports. Not printed yet.

history_note: V1 to V6 were built on a third-party case shell (Sakkez Games, Standard Digital File License). We kept what they taught us, not their geometry: IH1 is designed from scratch, so its files are ours to share.
